review.gallery: Five native renders in the 139-page developer brochure, split across two public files by Mitchell’s. Four matching villa and townhouse panels are cropped from the 86-page Azizi brochure mirrored by REM. Project images exclude generic Sharjah and lifestyle photography.
review.location: The brochure locates the masterplan along E311 and provides four indicative travel estimates. The printed zero minutes for E311 describes frontage, which appears as the access road.
review.floorPlans: All 32 original plan-book pages, including seven villa layouts, six townhouse block configurations and each printed corner and middle area. The source pack matches the corresponding plans in the expanded brochure. An additional full masterplan sheet shows six cluster locations.

unavailable: Exact entrance coordinates and verified apartment or retail drawings were not established. Published times apply to the community.
